name: CrowdSec-Threat-Map
description: CrowdSec Threat Map displays local CrowdSec alerts on an interactive world map with a live feed, English/French UI, larger readable text, CSV export, themes, optional unban support and optional dynamic whitelist support. Mount your CrowdSec database read-only for a safe dashboard-only setup.

paths.name: Paths - CrowdSec data
paths.description: CrowdSec data directory containing crowdsec.db and optionally GeoLite2-City.mmdb. Keep read-only for dashboard-only deployments.

paths.name: Paths - CrowdSec postoverflows
paths.description: Optional CrowdSec postoverflows directory. Required only if WHITELIST_ENABLED=true.

paths.name: Paths - Docker socket
paths.description: Optional Docker socket. Required only for dashboard unban or dynamic whitelist CrowdSec restart actions.

ports.name: WebUI - HTTP host port
ports.description: Host port for the CrowdSec Threat Map web dashboard.

variables.name: Core - SERVER_LAT
variables.description: Server marker latitude. Example for Paris: 48.8566.

variables.name: Core - SERVER_LON
variables.description: Server marker longitude. Example for Paris: 2.3522.

variables.name: Core - SERVER_NAME
variables.description: Display name for the server marker.

variables.name: CrowdSec - Container name
variables.description: CrowdSec Docker container name. Used only when Docker socket access is mounted for unban/whitelist actions.

variables.name: CrowdSec - Dynamic whitelist enabled
variables.description: Enable only if the postoverflows path is mounted read-write and Docker socket access is intentionally enabled.

variables.name: CrowdSec - Whitelist file
variables.description: Whitelist YAML path inside the container.

variables.name: CrowdSec - Whitelist interval
variables.description: How often the public IP is checked for dynamic whitelist updates, in seconds.

variables.name: CrowdSec - Restart wait
variables.description: Wait time after restarting CrowdSec for whitelist updates.

variables.name: CrowdSec - Restart cooldown
variables.description: Minimum time between automatic CrowdSec restarts for whitelist updates.

variables.name: CrowdSec - Unban API token
variables.description: Recommended when /unban is enabled. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. Leave empty only on trusted LAN deployments.

variables.name: Data - Days back
variables.description: How many days of CrowdSec alert history to display.
